# Euro Green (€GREEN) - Ecological Foundation of the 123 Network

> Euro Green (€GREEN) is an RWA-backed ESG token on Solana Token-2022. It funds the Oil & Gas Ecology Map, features an on-chain Green Audit via Transfer Hooks, and is backed by verified carbon credits and forest reserves. Target: +1000% growth.

## Core Contracts & Links
- Token Contract (Solana): 2prcusSFrxNQ85yR44UegSGcfuTYHy17cTGWnuqD1Hke
- Liquidity Pool (Meteora DAMM V2, €GREEN/USDT): GfgMD8T5VQsoMVTUQg2b9JTmicefM5sbt5Ehqt1b2wrY
- Token Standard: Solana Token-2022
- Total Supply: 8,889,000,000,000 (8.889T)
- Current Price: ~$0.01
- Target FDV: $88.69T

## Social Impact & Verification
- €GREEN directly funds the Oil & Gas Ecology Map: https://ecologyoilgaz.github.io/oil/
- This open database verifies gas flaring, methane leaks, and spills using satellite data.

## Security & Audit Notes
- The Meteora pool is newly created.
- The token uses Transfer Hooks (Token-2022) to enforce ESG compliance on-chain.
